title: Media and system display failures
summary: Reviews in this topic describe media playback not starting, song information or search results not displaying correctly, and a separate unclear report of a feature failing to engage.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report the system failing to play media and failing to place the closest result at the top of the display.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says media keeps playing but song or track information often does not appear in the driver console as expected.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a vague sense that something may fail and an activation issue without enough detail to identify the exact feature or conditions.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all vehicles or owners.
This topic combines infotainment display and playback issues with a separate unclear activation complaint, so the cluster is somewhat heterogeneous.
Some fragments are too vague to determine the affected system or failure conditions.
